categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC server metadata structures and `getblock` OpenRPC definitions in src/rpc/.
categories.rationale: Adds machine-readable OpenRPC metadata mapping `verbosity` parameter values to `getblock` result branches so client libraries do not have to hardcode them. As described in the PR, clients exposing typed methods per verbosity level currently have to hardcode the mapping because verbosity 2 and 3 responses can be structurally identical and cannot be reliably distinguished by response schema validation alone.
